what: Human ship decision for the phone app's image model. The ship rule itself is computed by model/field_eval.py and model/field_threshold.py; this file only records what the team decided and why. Read by model/evaluate.py, model/field_eval.py and model/field_threshold.py when they render reports.
decided_by: the Cafetal team (an explicit human decision, not the output of the ship-rule script)
rule_outcome: The pre-registered ship rule says DO NOT SHIP: v2 at t = 0.90 passes 4 of its 5 conditions and misses one (reports/field_v2_threshold_test.json)
exception: (2), JMuBEN test macro-F1 (argmax and app-level) may drop at most 1 point
reason: the Kenyan close-ups it no longer answers go to the fail-safe "No estoy seguro" (DUDA: show the leaf to the officer), not to wrong answers, and it never called a diseased leaf "sano" on either test set; and v2 is the only model that finds rust in field photos (v1 finds none on the held-out field test).
